Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

zoo — a place where wild animals live. Example: At the zoo there are lions.
animal — a living creature, like a dog. Example: Don't feed the animals.
lion — a large wild cat. Example: There are two lions.
tiger — a large wild cat with stripes. Example: Are there any tigers?
elephant — a very large grey animal. Example: Elephants are very big.
monkey — an animal that climbs trees. Example: Monkeys can climb.
bear — a large heavy wild animal. Example: The bear is in the forest.
bird — an animal with wings and feathers. Example: Birds can fly.
wild — living in nature, not tame. Example: It is a wild animal.
feed — to give food to an animal. Example: You mustn't feed the animals.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• There are two lions.
• Monkeys can climb.
• Don't feed the animals.
• It is a wild animal.
• Look at the birds!

Grammar focus: Plural nouns.
Use plural nouns for animals: There are two lions. Use can for abilities: Monkeys can climb. Use mustn't for zoo rules: You mustn't feed the animals.
